```{python}
import h5py

# ————————————————————————————————————————
# Function to read and print HDF5 file structure
# ————————————————————————————————————————
def print_hdf5_structure(file_name):
    with h5py.File(file_name, 'r') as f:
        def visitor(name, obj):
            if isinstance(obj, h5py.Group):
                print(f"\nGroup: {name or '/'}")
                for k, v in obj.attrs.items():
                    print(f"  Attr - {k}: {v}")

            elif isinstance(obj, h5py.Dataset):
                print(f"\nDataset: {name}")
                print(f"  Shape: {obj.shape}")
                print(f"  Dtype: {obj.dtype}")
                if obj.dtype.names:  # compound datatype
                    print(f"  Compound fields: {obj.dtype.names}")
                    # Print first few entries
                    sample = obj[:5]
                    print("  First 5 entries:", sample)

        f.visititems(visitor)

        with h5py.File(file_name, 'r') as f:
            # Print the root group attributes
            print("\nRoot Group Attributes:")
            for key, value in f.attrs.items():
                print(f"  {key}: {value}")
    return

print_hdf5_structure(file_name)


fields = []

with h5py.File(file_name, 'r') as f:
    for key, value in f.attrs.items():
        name = str(value, 'utf-8')
        if name.find('component'):
            fields.append(name)
```

```{python}
def plot_field(field_name):
    ds = yt.load(file_name)

    dd = ds.r[::64j,::64j,::64j]
    phi = dd[field_name]

    plt.imshow(phi[:, :, 0])#, vmin=phi.min(), vmax=phi.max(), cmap='viridis')
    plt.title(field_name)
    plt.colorbar()

for field in fields:
    plot_field(field)
```
